purpose: Free but recorded co-creation before a route-typed candidature dossier exists

brainstorming.minimum: One primary formulation and at least one relevant alternative across problem, primary target, mechanism and scale, with provenance and convergence reasons
brainstorming.exception: If no relevant alternative can be constructed, record a localized evidence-backed reason and owner; the validator judges whether the exception is credible
brainstorming.binding: idea_version must equal the reviewed decision version

recommendation_meanings.PROCEED: The exact route/call context is verified enough for a project dossier; no decisive mismatch remains and open questions have credible owners/plans. This authorizes only handoff to idea-validation.
recommendation_meanings.REFINE: The core route and problem are plausible, but material assumptions, targets, causal links, scale or evidence need bounded repair before handoff.
recommendation_meanings.PIVOT: A valuable problem remains, but route, target, mechanism, solution or scale is materially misaligned; compare and select a substantially different option.
recommendation_meanings.STOP: No credible supported route/problem fit remains, or an ethical/legal/mission incompatibility makes further candidacy design unjustified on current evidence.

decision_precedence: STOP when a decisive incompatibility has no credible repair or pivot
PIVOT when the problem remains valuable but a core route/target/mechanism/scale mismatch requires a different concept
REFINE when the core concept remains plausible and gaps can be resolved without changing its identity
PROCEED only when every mandatory axis is adequate and no hard blocker remains

proceed_requires.human_choice: observed for exact idea version and selected route

hard_blockers: No exact supported/current route can plausibly host the intervention
Primary participants/beneficiaries, organisations, activities or geography conflict with the selected call
Problem is unsupported and there is no credible evidence plan
Solution has no plausible mechanism linking it to the stated problem
Scale/resource model is incompatible with the call and cannot be rescaled without changing the concept
Critical organisational/partner capacity is absent with no credible acquisition plan
Ethical, safeguarding, legal or mission incompatibility

priority_layers.contents: Current Program Guide/call, exact action objectives and priorities, eligibility, award criteria, national provisions when applicable
Horizontal and sector-specific Erasmus+ priorities actually applicable to the route

European Youth Goals/EU Youth Strategy and other verified EU frameworks relevant to target and mechanism. If the exact action/call explicitly incorporates one, record that official role and locator; otherwise it remains contextual and never substitutes call fit or becomes an invented award criterion.

route_discovery.when_missing: Search current official calls and the registered route catalogue; return a shortlist, not a silent default
route_discovery.selection_rule: Compare at least one credible alternative when available and preserve why it was rejected; unresolved current-call evidence prevents PROCEED

targets.primary: People or organizations directly experiencing the evidenced need and intended direct change; must match the exact call role/participant/beneficiary rules.
targets.secondary: Actors indirectly benefiting, enabling implementation, adoption or wider effects; must be separately named and must not inflate eligible participant or direct beneficiary counts.

causal_chain.impact_policy: Use only relevant levels, distinguish contribution from attribution, and do not treat dissemination reach as impact.

budget_scale.policy: Retrieve the exact current financial model before using amounts; budget tiers may be official options, estimates or not applicable and these statuses must remain distinct.
budget_scale.limit: Phase0 tests proportionality and strategic feasibility; it does not create the detailed budget or declare costs eligible.

human_and_fresh_gates.assistant_output: Evidence-based recommendation with weaknesses, alternatives and strengthening directions
human_and_fresh_gates.human_output: Observed choice of exact version and route; not approval of a nomination bundle
human_and_fresh_gates.validator_output: Independent accept/revise/blocked on evidence, internal coherence and recommendation discipline; not preference substitution or official scoring
human_and_fresh_gates.promotion: Only accepted PROCEED plus observed human route/version choice may create a projects/<ID>/ dossier; idea-validation remains mandatory

reasoning_record_policy: Store alternatives, decision matrix, evidence, assumptions, unresolved questions and concise reasons; never store private chain-of-thought.
